strings.zh: q-sw 532 nm KTP(皮秒 / 奈秒)
q-sw 755 nm 亞歷山大(皮秒)

strings.en: Deeper pigment or yellowish-brown skin tones

strings.zh: 大面積、輕微病灶經濟選擇
strings.en: Economical option for large areas with mild lesions

strings.zh: 太田母斑首選；通常需 5-10 次，間隔 2-3 個月
strings.en: First-line for nevus of Ota; typically 5–10 sessions at 2–3 month intervals

strings.zh: 必須低能量、多次小傷害，單次能量過高反引發反黑
strings.en: Must use low energy with multiple gentle treatments; high single-pass energy worsens hyperpigmentation

strings.zh: 非選擇性熱破壞，適合 III-V 型膚色
strings.en: Non-selective thermal injury; suitable for skin types III–V

strings.zh: 1550 nm 鉺玻璃飛梭(非破壞性)
585-595 nm 染料雷射 PDL(V Beam)
對紅斑、毛細血管擴張、潮紅都有效
strings.en: Effective for erythema, telangiectasia, and flushing

strings.zh: 適合明顯紅斑與血絲；治療後可能短暫紫斑
strings.en: Suitable for prominent erythema and visible vessels; transient purpura possible

strings.zh: 1064 nm Nd:YAG(用於增厚轉變部位)
恢復期短，適合在意 downtime 者
strings.en: Short downtime; suitable for those who can't tolerate recovery time

strings.zh: 效果最佳但需 5-7 天恢復期、有 PIH 風險
strings.en: Best results but requires 5–7 days downtime with PIH risk

strings.zh: 恢復較 CO₂ 短，黃膚色較安全
strings.en: Shorter recovery than CO₂; safer for yellow-toned skin

strings.zh: 染料雷射 / IPL(針對紅色疤痕成分)
strings.en: Pulsed dye laser / IPL (for red scar component)

strings.zh: 痘疤紅期 — 先打 PDL/IPL 退紅再做飛梭

退紅效果好，合併類固醇注射
strings.en: Effective at reducing redness; combine with steroid injection

strings.zh: 1064 nm Nd:YAG(較厚 / 較深膚色)
1540-1550 nm 鉺玻璃飛梭(扁平 keloid)
效果最佳，需 5-7 天恢復期

strings.zh: 效果強但風險(PIH、感染)較高
strings.en: Strong efficacy but higher risk (PIH, infection)

strings.zh: IV-VI 型(較深膚色)、深層粗毛

strings.zh: 穿透不足，效果不如新世代
